hero.title.en: Pick your number, pay with Telebirr, and the lottery draw happens inside that house.
hero.title.am: ቁጥርዎን ይምረጡ፣ በቴሌቢር ይከፍሉ፣ ዕጣው በዚያ ቤት ውስጥ ይካሄዳል።

hero.body.en: Every house has its own price. One house is 20 birr, one is 100 birr, one is 5000 birr. When a house is full, the lottery draw runs automatically between the participants of that house, and the whole prize pool goes to 3 winning numbers.
hero.body.am: በእያንዳንዱ ቤት የራሱ ዋጋ አለው። አንድ ቤት 20 ብር ነው። አንድ 100 ብር ነው። አንድ 5000 ብር ነው። ቤቱ ሲሞላ፣ ዕጣው በራስ-ሰር በዚያ ቤት ተሳታፊዎች መካከል ይካሄዳል። ሙሉው የሽልማት ገንዘብ ወደ 3 ቁጥሮች ይሄዳሉ።

hero.rule.en: The number you hold is public. Your name is never stored and never shown.
hero.rule.am: የያዙት ቁጥር ይፋዊ ነው። ስምህ በጭራሽ አይከማችም እና በጭራሽ አይታይም።
hero.rule.back: The number you hold is public. Your name will never be stored and will never be displayed.

draws.subtitle.en: A lottery draw runs by itself as soon as a house is full, using only the participants of that house.

draws.empty.en: No lottery draw has finished yet.

draws.seedNote.en: The seed and the verification hash are published. Anyone can re-check that the winning number came out of these participants.
draws.seedNote.am: ዘሩና የማረጋገጫ ሃሹ ለሁሉ ግልጽ ነው። ማንኛውም አሸናፊው ቁጥር ከእነዚህ ተሳታፊዎች መካከል እንዴት እንደወጣ ማረጋገጥ ይችላል።

draws.payoutPending.en: The pot is recorded and waits for payout.

rules.price.en: Each house has its own price. The price is not equal to the number of participants.
rules.price.am: በእያንዳንዱ ቤት የራሱ ዋጋ አለው። ዋጋው ከተሳታፊዎች ብዛት ጋር እኩል አይደለም።

rules.pick.en: You choose the number yourself. Free numbers are open to everyone in the house.
rules.pick.am: ቁጥሩን እራስዎ ይመርጣሉ። ነፃ ቁጥሮች በቤቱ ውስጥ ላሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ክፍት ናቸው።

rules.pay.en: You pay through your Telebirr digital wallet. A number becomes yours only after Telebirr confirms the payment.
rules.pay.am: በቴሌቢር ዲጂታል መለያዎ ክፍያዎን ይከፍላሉ። ቴሌቢር ክፍያዎን ሲያረጋገጥ ብቻ ቁጥሩ የእርስዎ ይሆናል።

rules.fee.en: Each participant pays the house price and nothing extra. The service charge is cut out of that money: it is twenty five percent of the payment. What is left goes to the prize pool. In a twenty birr house five birr is the service charge and fifteen birr goes to the prizes.
rules.fee.am: ተሳታፊው የቤቱን ዋጋ ብቻ ይከፍላል። የአገልግሎት ክፍያው ከዋጋው ውስጥ 25 በመቶ ይቀንሳል። የቀረው ለሽልማት ነው። ለምሳሌ በ20 ብር ቤት ውስጥ 5 ብር የአገልግሎት ክፍያ ነው፣ 15 ብር ለሽልማት ነው።

rules.draw.en: When the house is full the lottery draw runs automatically between its participants. Three numbers take the whole prize pool: 1st, 2nd and 3rd.
rules.draw.am: ቤቱ ሲሞላ ዕጣ ማውጫው በራስ-ሰር በቤቱ ተሳታፊዎች መካከል ይካሄዳል። 3 ቁጥሮች ሙሉውን የሽልማት ገንዘብ ይወሰዳሉ፥ 1ኛ፣ 2ኛ፣ 3ኛ።

rules.privacy.en: Everyone sees numbers and prices. Nobody sees names or phone numbers.
rules.privacy.am: ሁሉም ሰው ቁጥሮችን እና ዋጋዎችን ይመለከታል። ማንም ሰው ስሞችን ወይም ስልክ ቁጥሮችን አያይም።

footer.note.en: Lucky is a demo of a lottery draw flow. Running it with real money needs a Telebirr merchant contract and a licence for the lottery draw itself.
footer.note.am: ላኪ የዕጣ ማውጫ ሂደት ዴሞ ነው። በእውነት ገንዘብ ለማካሄድ የቴሌቢር ሻጭ ውልና የዕጣ ማውጫ ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋል።
